title: Hybrid seat + compute-credit packaging and security questionnaire mapping playbook
creator: Leah Ortiz
description: Goal: Define a defensible, experiment-ready packaging model for Private/VPC and on-prem customers that combines a per-seat entitlement with monthly compute credits, clear optional Dedicated capacity add-ons, and mapped artifacts for enterprise security questionnaires (SQs). Rationale: Many large customers ask for both predictable license fees for seat-based access and flexible compute billing for variable inference workloads. A hybrid model reduces procurement friction (clear headcount cost) while aligning unit economics to consumption. Scope: pricing structure (seat + credits + reserved capacity), three support tiers and their SLAs, controlled upgrade cadence options, legal-friendly contract terms for pilots and multiyear commitments, and an SQ mapping playbook that lists the exact artifacts and answers for common enterprise questionnaire sections (security controls, data residency, encryption, patching, and incident response). Out of scope: per-model micro-pricing, marketplace-only packaging, and embedded hardware sales. Success metrics: conversion rate from pilot to paid enterprise contract > 45% for pilots using this packaging; average contract ARR increase 20% vs. baseline; decrease in security questionnaire turnaround time to <7 business days for packaged responses.
proposed_pricing: Baseline seat license: $2,500 per named admin seat per year (covers Console + control plane access)
Compute credits: bundles sold monthly or prepaid annual packs; example: 100k token credits = $1,200/month list; overage billed at negotiated rate; annual prepay discount 15%
Reserved capacity add-on: Dedicated pool blocks sold as vGPU-month commitments; example: 1xA100-equivalent block = $12,000/month with SLA; scaled tiers and burst options configurable
Commit discounts: 12-month term 10% off total, 36-month 18% off; enterprise volume tiers for >$250k ARR negotiations
support_tiers: Standard: business-hours email + 48h P1 response, quarterly platform upgrades allowed within customer blackout windows
Priority: 24/7 chat + 8h P1 response, 1 guaranteed minor hotfix within 72h, monthly upgrade window coordinated with customer
Platinum: 24/7 phone + 2h P1 response SLA, on-call rotation for critical incidents, optional white-glove weekly ops call and custom maintenance windows
upgrade_cadence_options: Managed auto-updates (recommended for small pilots): quarterly minor updates, major upgrades biannually; customers can opt out with 30-day notice
Scheduled vetted upgrades (recommended for enterprise): vendor-scheduled 8-week windows; customer chooses 1-of-3 windows per calendar quarter
Controlled manual upgrades: customer-managed in on-prem scenarios with vendor-provided upgrade bundles and runbook; security-only hotfixes can be applied outside windows under emergency SLA
sq_mapping_summary: SQ playbook includes a mapping table that links common questionnaire items to artifacts: SOC2 report link, cloud network diagram (VPC layout), KMS/HSM configuration docs, patching cadence evidence, third-party pen test report, incident response runbook, retention & deletion policy

Pre-built answers for typical sections: Data Handling (GDPR), Access Controls (RBAC + SSO), Encryption (in transit + at rest with key ownership options), Physical Security (for on-prem notes), Change Management & Patching
Deliverables pack: single ZIP with PDF SOC2 attestation, redacted network diagram, sample SAML metadata, copy of standard SLA and support scope, MD5/sha checksums for upgrade packages
Turnaround target: re-usable playbook reduces manual review time; aim <7 business days for first-pass answers in pilot packaging
experiments: A/B test price anchoring: present seat-first vs. credit-first packaging to matched sales cohorts and measure pilot acceptance & negotiated discounts
Pilot offer: 3-month pilot with reduced seat license (50%) + 50k credits trial and option-to-convert clause; measure conversion and average ARR after 6 months
Negotiation flexibility experiment: expose configurable line-items (demo of Dedicated add-on) to AE dashboard and track discounting patterns and time-to-sign
SQ fast-track: offer 'SQ response + dedicated bridge' as a paid add-on for high-touch deals and measure time savings and win-rate uplift
rollout_plan: Week 0-2: finalize list prices and artwork for AE playbook; legal to approve term templates and option-to-convert language
Week 3-5: pilot with 3 existing POCs (Sales identified); enable billing SKU for seat+credit bundles and a simple online quote generator for AE
Week 6-12: collect pilot outcomes, run A/B analysis, iterate pricing bands; begin populating SQ playbook artifacts in shared drive
Week 13: recommend go/no-go and handoff to Sales Ops for broader enablement; prepare contract templates for 12- and 36-month terms
open_questions: Exact seat definition for different personas (admin seats vs inference-only users) — should inference-only nodes count as seats or only compute credits?
How to price sustained vs. spiky workloads — should we introduce separate sustained-commit credits?
Legal: what limitations do we need for upgrade postponement and liability during scheduled windows?
Billing: can existing hosted customers convert to hybrid with credit rollover? (Finance input required)
